| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ἀπροτίμαστος (19.263) | "untouched" | "untouched" (+ note: sense traditional, formation unclear) | "unhonoured", "unharmed", "unmolested"; the sense follows the context of the oath |
| θεῷ ἐναλίγκιος αὐδήν (19.250, of Talthybius) | "like a god in voice" | "whose voice was like a god’s" | "godlike" (reserved for ἀντίθεος), "with a voice like a god"; follows the Odyssey’s θεοῖς ἐναλίγκιος αὐδήν "like the gods in voice" / "whose voice is like the gods’" |
| κούρητες Ἀχαιῶν (19.248) | "the young men of the Achaeans" | "the young men of the Achaeans" | "the Curetes" (a people, not meant here), "youths", "squires" |
| πρόφασις (πρόφασιν after εὐνῆς … κεχρημένος 19.262; Πάτροκλον πρόφασιν 19.302) | "pretext" | "pretext" | "excuse", "reason", "cause"; the same rendering at both places |
| ἀμήχανος (of Agamemnon, 19.273) | "past all dealing with" | "impossible to deal with" | "helpless" (the Odyssey’s word, 19.363: said by Achilles of Agamemnon, who is being blamed, it would ask for pity); not a new departure, it follows the Iliad table’s ἀμήχανος of persons (10.167, 13.726, 15.14, 16.29) |
| ἄτη · ἄτας (19.270) | "bewilderments" | "bewilderments" | "delusions", "blindness", "ruin"; follows iliad-053 (9.115) |
| ἰκέλη χρυσέῃ Ἀφροδίτῃ (of Briseis, 19.282) | "like golden Aphrodite" | "who was like golden Aphrodite" | "like the golden Aphrodite" (an article the Greek lacks), "as lovely as Aphrodite" |
| ὀλέθριον ἦμαρ (19.294) | "the day of destruction" | "their day of destruction" | "day of doom" (reserved for αἴσιμον ἦμαρ and similar), "fatal day", "ruinous day" (kept for οὐλόμενος); ὄλεθρος "destruction" |
| κηδείους (19.294) | "beloved" | "dear to me" | "kinsmen", "cherished"; sense "dear, cared for" |
| ὠκὺς Ἀχιλλεύς (19.295, without πόδας) | "swift Achilles" | "swift Achilles" | "swift-footed" (reserved for ποδάρκης, ποδώκης), "swift of foot" (πόδας ὠκύς) |
| ἄμοτον (19.300) | "without ceasing" | "without ceasing" | "insatiably", "furiously"; adverb, "insatiably, unceasingly" |
| μείλιχος (19.300) | "gentle" | "gentle" | "kind", "sweet"; follows the table’s μείλιχος (17.671) |
| ἁδινῶς (19.314) | "heavily" | "heavy" (in "heaved a heavy sigh") | "thickly", "in crowds", "shrilly"; the Odyssey table’s ἁδινόν "heavily" (the adverb) |
| ἀνενείκατο (19.314) | "drew up" | "heaved a sigh" (+ note: the Greek names no object) | "groaned" (decides the object), "lifted his voice", "recovered" |
| δυσάμμορος (19.315) | "ill-fated" | "ill-fated one" | "unlucky", "wretched" (reserved for δύστηνος; δειλός is "miserable", as in 19.287), "ill-starred"; δυσ- "ill" + ἄμμορος "without a share" |
| λαρὸν δεῖπνον (19.316; λαρός, exact sense not known) | "a tasty meal" | "a tasty meal" (+ note: exact sense of λαρός not known) | "delicious", "pleasant"; follows the table’s λαρὸν δόρπον "a tasty supper" (12.283) |
| ἄκμηνος (19.320) | "fasting" | "goes without" | "starved", "hungry", "empty"; rare word, sense from context |
| ποθή (19.321) | "longing" | "longing" | "yearning", "desire", "grief" |
| ῥιγεδανή (Ἑλένης, 19.325) | "horrible" | "horrible" (+ note: exact sense not known) | "chilling", "shuddering", "hateful"; probably tied to ῥῖγος "shudder, cold" |
| πολέμου στόμα (19.313) | "the mouth of war" | "the mouth of bloody war" | "the thick of war", "the jaws of war", "the front of battle"; στόμα "mouth" |
| τέρπω (active, 19.312; middle, 19.313) | "cheer" / "be cheered" | "trying to cheer" / "took no cheer" | "delight", "gladden"; "take one’s fill" stays for the middle in τάρπημεν |
| ὄρχαμε λαῶν (19.289) | "leader of the people" | "leader of the people" | table, unchanged (14.102) |
| κεχρημένος (19.262) | "needing" | "wanting" (+ note: construction rough, best reading) | "using", "lacking"; χράομαι/χρῄζω "need, want" |
| στόμαχος (19.266) | "throat" | "throat" | "gullet", "neck" |
| ἀρξάμενος (κάπρου ἀπὸ τρίχας ἀρξάμενος, 19.254) | "having made first-offering of hairs from the boar" | "making a first offering of hairs from the boar" | "beginning", "starting with"; ἀπαρχόμενος "make a first offering" |
| ἦ ῥά νυ (19.315) | "Truly, then" | "Truly" | "Surely", "Indeed" |
| πυκινῶς ἀκαχήμενον (19.312) | "thickly grieved" | "sorely grieved as he was" | "often", "again and again" (taking πυκινῶς with τέρποντες), "in his grief"; follows the Odyssey’s πυκινῶς ἀκαχήμενος ἦτορ (20.84) "thickly grieved" / "sorely grieved", with ἀκαχήμενος "grieved" |
| λίγ’ ἐκώκυε (19.284) | "was crying out clearly" | "cried out in a clear voice" | "wailed" (kept for οἰμώζω), "shrilly" (turned down for λιγύς, which is "clear"); follows the table’s κώκυσεν "cried out" (18.37) and λιγέως "clearly" / "in a clear voice" (3.214) |
| δειλός (μοι δειλῇ, 19.287) | "miserable" | "miserable as I am" | "wretched" (reserved for δύστηνος); follows the table’s δειλός "miserable" |
| κεχαρισμένε θυμῷ (πλεῖστον κεχαρισμένε θυμῷ, 19.287) | "made most welcome to my heart" | "dearest to my heart" | "most pleasing to my heart"; follows the table’s κεχαρισμένε θυμῷ (5.243) with the superlative added |
| αἰνὸν ἄχος (19.307) | "fearsome grief" | "fearsome grief" | "dread grief"; follows the table’s αἰνὸν ἄχος (4.169) |
| ἀγγελίη λυγρή (ἐμὴν … λυγρὴν ἀγγελίην, 19.336–337) | "grievous news" | "grievous news" | "grim message" ("message" withdrawn, "grim" kept for other words); follows the table’s ἀγγελίη "news" and λυγρός "grievous" |
